set.body:
Purpose

Make the metric the branch point for semantics and lowering. Publicly distinguish a same-space PSD metric from a cross-space bridge.

Capabilities

At minimum identify identity, native-diagonal, feature-additive, support-dense, fixed, and learned-recipe cases. Only compiler-proven feature-additive metrics may use the global WA collapse.

Component law

For an SPD metric K and raw coherent covector a, test the candidate exact split

K_coh = a a^T / (a^T K^-1 a)
K_cfg = K - K_coh.

Acceptance

- K_coh is rank one PSD, K_cfg is PSD, and their effect forms sum exactly.
- With K = D(w) and a = w/sum(w), the law reproduces the existing coherent/configuration values exactly.
- With K = Sigma^-1, the coherent amplitude remains the declared raw regional mean while its energy is noise-normalized.
- Coordinate-change and signed cross-partition laws pass independent oracles.
- Singular or cross-space cases refuse the component unless their required capability is explicit.
- Component identity includes both metric and coherent-functional signatures.
set.title: Epic 2: Define metric capabilities and exact metric-aware components
